name: std::operator<<(std::error_code)
intro:
Performs stream output operation on error code ec.

Equivalent to os << ec.category().name() << ':' << ec.value().

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
os

 -

 output stream to insert data to


 ec

 -

 error code

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Represent invalid_argument, inspect it, copy it, and clear it. Error messages depend on the implementation.
